hero.eyebrow: 5 Yrs · Pop-ups · Exhibition Renewals · IMC Campaigns
hero.position_sub: Designing spaces, content and campaigns from data
hero.tagline:
Five years at T Factory, SK Telecom's flagship store —
planning and running pop-ups, exhibition renewals and IMC campaigns.

about.block1: A brand marketer who designs what a brand wants to say into customer experience, A to Z.
about.block2: Five years planning brand pop-ups and flagship retail experiences at SK Telecom's T Factory. From space and content planning through budget and agency coordination, operating models and crew training, to post-launch performance analysis — owning projects from first brief to final read-out.
about.block3: Sets direction from quantitative and qualitative data. Analyses visitor volume, dwell time and customer feedback, feeds it into the next plan, and turns it into measurable results — 1.8× purchase conversion against target, 40× dwell-time growth. Recently applying AI tools in daily work to speed up planning and documentation.

career.sub: Retail Innovation Team / SKT Flagship Store, T Factory

experience.name: Student Council, College of Foreign Languages — Planning Div.

philosophy.front_quote: What a brand wants to say,

items.text: Define the problem and set the target from on-site data and market analysis.
Design space, content and campaign so they run as one uninterrupted flow.
Track performance metrics and carry the insight into the next plan.

process.title: Set the big picture — from space and exhibition planning to marketing and content direction
Manage schedule and budget, and lead communication with partner teams and agencies
Design the on-site operating model and turn it into an executable manual
Train the crew and take ownership of on-site operations
Analyse performance data, draw out improvements, and feed them into the next plan

main_projects.title: 0 Youth Plan × Foldable 5 Pop-up
main_projects.desc: Data showed the absence of hands-on content was driving drop-off. Shifting to an experience-led format lifted dwell time 40×.
main_projects.panel_title: SKT 0 Youth Mobile Plan × Foldable 5 Pop-up Store
main_projects.problem: A display-only promotion could not hold visitor attention, so the plan launch needed experience-led content rather than signage. Dwell-time data on the existing device display showed the absence of hands-on content was the core reason visitors left.
points: Set content direction and designed the hands-on experience concept
Designed experience-zone staffing and the customer-response process
Wrote response scripts and ran on-site crew training
Led communication across the partner brand, business teams and agencies
main_projects.result: Dwell time grew 40× versus the previous flagship device display, and on-site guidance converted into 41 mobile-plan subscriptions.

main_projects.title: “NAN-ZERO” Resale Campaign
main_projects.desc: Set the “Zero Doubt · Zero Worry · Zero Markup” USP and owned everything from branding to the pop-up store. 55% sell-through.
main_projects.problem: The used-phone business needed end-to-end planning across branding, marketing and the offline pop-up, from intake to sale. Lowering the consumer trust barrier around used devices was the core challenge.
points: Proposed the brand name, key message and key visual guideline
Planned the space layout and the customer experience flow
Set content and posting cadence by marketing channel
Wrote on-site response scenarios and scripts, and ran crew training
main_projects.result: Achieved 55% purchase conversion against initial inventory. As a test-bed project, it surfaced customer, marketing and distribution insights for the business case.

main_projects.title: Skt.zip Renewal (2nd Edition)
main_projects.desc: Cross-analysing completion and traffic data diagnosed low immersion. A full content redesign moved three KPIs at once.
main_projects.problem: Falling completion rates and declining floor traffic called for a renewal that strengthened immersion and message delivery. Cross-analysing completion and traffic data diagnosed weak content immersion as the cause.
points: Re-selected the experience services, products and technologies on display
Planned the core content and designed the UX flow
Designed the operating model and the customer experience
Owned agency communication
main_projects.result: Reached 75% average completion among 2F visitors, doubled 2F traffic versus the previous concept, and scored 4.5 / 5 satisfaction from completing visitors.

main_projects.title: X Caliber Experience UX
main_projects.desc: Designed a B2B AI service into a jargon-free, interaction-led experience that lands in three minutes.
main_projects.panel_title: X Caliber — Experience Content UX Planning
main_projects.problem: An AI-assisted diagnostic B2B service needed an intuitive content UX/UI so that general visitors could grasp and experience it without technical background.
points: Set the UX/UI logic and planned the detail screens
Ran business-team communication and secured resources
Designed the operating model and the customer experience
Researched the components required to build the experience zone
main_projects.result: 1.5× more visitors completed the experience versus the main exhibition floor, and the zone ranked 3rd of 14 items in the “best service experience” visitor survey.

other_projects.title: SKT S26 Market
other_projects.desc: Galaxy S26 launch pop-up. Ran 10 experience zones and trained 28 crew.
other_projects.problem: Operations planning for the SKT pre-order and purchase-benefit pop-up tied to the Samsung Galaxy S26 launch.
points: Wrote the operating plan for 10 experience zones
Wrote the customer-response scripts
Led training for 28 crew members
other_projects.result_panel: Ran 10 experience zones and completed training for 28 crew members.

other_projects.title: T Universe UX Planning
other_projects.desc: Rebuilt the subscription service into a UX-flow-led experience.
other_projects.panel_title: T Universe — Experience Content UX Planning
other_projects.problem: To promote the subscription service, the content was designed as a UX-flow-led hands-on experience.
points: Planned the UX flow and screens
Designed the subscription-service experience scenario
other_projects.result_panel: Roughly 5× more visitors completed the experience versus the previous content.

other_projects.title: SKT Brand Center Skt.zip
other_projects.desc: Initial renewal design and the center's first official opening.
other_projects.problem: Designed the center's initial renewal around hands-on content built on SKT products and services.
points: Selected the experience services and planned the content
Designed the operating model and the customer experience
other_projects.result_panel: Delivered the brand center's first official opening with a 60% average entry rate among all site visitors.

other_projects.title: LCK T1 Merch & Viewing Party
other_projects.desc: Merchandise line and viewing-party events built for the T1 fan base.
other_projects.problem: Planned and ran seasonal merchandise and viewing-party events targeting the T1 fan base.
points: Planned seasonal merchandise and managed outsourced production
Planned viewing-party operations and ran the events on site
other_projects.result_panel: T1 zone traffic +40%, merchandise sales +20% during the viewing-party window, and social story tags up 5×.

other_projects.title: Merch Package Redesign
other_projects.desc: Five eco-friendly ESG merchandise items, planned and produced.
other_projects.problem: Planned and oversaw outsourced production of five eco-friendly merchandise items reflecting the company's ESG commitments.
points: Set the ESG-based concept and selected materials
Selected production vendors and managed quality
other_projects.result_panel: Tour applications more than tripled immediately after the merchandise launch.

other_projects.title: One-Day Classes Tied to Main Exhibition
other_projects.desc: Five classes planned and run alongside the exhibition content
other_projects.result: 200+ applicants each · all sold out early
other_projects.panel_title: One-Day Classes Tied to the Main Exhibition
other_projects.problem: The main exhibition needed hands-on classes planned and operated in step with its content.
points: Planned programmes tied to the exhibition theme
Secured instructors and owned operations
other_projects.result_panel: Averaged 200+ applicants per class, with registration closing early every time.

other_projects.title: Response Scripts & Crew Training
other_projects.desc: Customer-response scripts and training for the space and main exhibition
other_projects.problem: Strengthening customer-response capability for the space and main exhibition required both scripts and a training system.
points: Wrote the customer-response scripts
Planned and ran crew training end to end
other_projects.result_panel: Trained 24 crew members in total, embedding the response manual and establishing the operating system.
